objective: Test whether native output probabilities identify financial transcription and table-association errors.
primary_signal: Geometric mean native probability of tokens overlapping emitted numeric values, excluding markup; no reference used to select tokens.
reference_policy: Keep human confirmations unchanged; assistant corrections and public benchmark annotations retain distinct provenance. No inferred human approval.

cohorts.sponsor: Existing development data; repair three incomplete regions in a new run, splitting the three Hippodrome subtables. Original run remains immutable.
cohorts.public_benchmark: Deterministically sample 60 FinTabNet test tables before model output inspection, max two per issuer and <=250 cells. Official benchmark labels; model pretraining overlap unknown.
cohorts.fresh_public: Source-checked digital and real scanned tables from four newly downloaded reports, separate from benchmark data.
cohorts.stress: Optional image degradations grouped with their source issuer; report separately from natural documents.

validation: Within each model, hold out entire issuers. Fit calibration and choose any secondary signal using training issuers only. Compare prediction error with a training-mean baseline. Bootstrap issuers, not cells. Do not call retrospective development diagnostics untouched test results.
constraints: One heavy recognizer at a time
No quality guarantee from token certainty
No destructive cleanup or automatic publication
completion: Usable local prototype with native evidence, structure-aware errors, held-out diagnostics, tests, and concise measured conclusions. Negative findings are valid.
